rejections.name: Flow rate
rejections.reason: BLFC is a brine line flow control sold in four sizes, parts 60022-12, 60022-25, 60022-50 and 60022-100, from .125 to 1.0 gpm; 12.5 gpm is not printed and the name covers all four.

rejections.name: Capacité nominale
rejections.reason: The table gives OM34K's cells "15,095 @ 3 4" and "34,433 @ 16 7" before OM40K's "18,143 @ 4 12" and "41,386 @ 20 0"; 34,433 grains is OM34K's.

rejections.name: Maximum operating pressure
rejections.reason: A by-pass setting, not a maximum: the by-pass "is set to begin opening at about 40 psi".

rejections.name: Flow rate
rejections.reason: Five parts share the name, "BLFC Assy 3/8", Blank" to "1.0 GPM"; 1.0 GPM is part 61450-100 only.
